source: EPA NVFEL benchmark test-data package, workbook '4- 2015 Ford 2.7L EcoBoost V6 Engine Tier 3 Fuel HD1 - Test Data.xlsx' (package directory 2015-ford-2.7l-ecoboost-v6-engine-tier3-fuel-hd-test-data-package-dated-11-27-19); public data, https://www.epa.gov/vehicle-and-fuel-emissions-testing/ (urls in out/epa_turbo_dl/urls.txt). Literal workbook readings rounded to 6 significant digits; nothing derived except the normalised cam signs, the two-bank lambda mean and the envelope / high_load flags.
selection: light load: map_kpa <= 60.0, 0.95 <= lambda <= 1.05, bmep_bar >= 0.3 (no-knock check: true knock limit >= measured spark)

cam_convention.normalised: intake_cam_adv_deg positive = advanced; exhaust_cam_ret_deg positive = retarded
